summary.conclusion: CORRECTED per docs/adr/0029-context-enrichment-hypothesis-not-established.md — supersedes this file's own original conclusion (context_layer/experiment_20260815_context_fix.json, commit 2b7c8a6), which claimed the context-enriched query caused Claim 20260811T165911_04's status change. That claim is factually wrong. 1 of 5 re-run Claims (20260811T165911_04) changed status from unverifiable (2026-08-13 original run) to verified (2026-08-15 re-run); the other 4 remained unverifiable in both runs. An audit of the original run's raw Linkup results, recovered from evidence_package/output/_m4_staging_20260813T114717.json, found the source responsible for the status change (AdIndex.ru) already present in that run's result set (position 6 of 20) — before context_layer existed. It was also present in the 2026-08-15 re-run's result set (position 9 of 20). The query's additive context terms did not cause this source to appear; it was discoverable under the original novelty+basis-only query the whole time. What actually changed the status was that the 2026-08-13 run's interactive assessment evaluated a different, weaker candidate from the same result set (begemot.ai, an AI-generated content site) and rejected it without evaluating AdIndex.ru on its merits; the 2026-08-15 re-run's fresh assessment pass evaluated AdIndex.ru directly and found genuine topical/causal support. This is a reassessment effect, not a context-enrichment effect. Milestone 4's experiment design changed two variables at once (query text and assessment pass) and cannot isolate which one caused the change; for this specific Claim, the audit shows definitively it was not the query. This experiment is therefore a confound, not support for D-025's context-loss hypothesis. D-025 remains neither confirmed nor refuted. Secondary finding: context_layer's query enrichment did not destroy AdIndex.ru's discoverability — it survived the query's shift toward an election-observation-heavy result cluster and remained in the top 20 — a narrower, more defensible claim than 'context enrichment fixed verification.'
